summary_1line: Vidura teaches Dhritarashtra that righteousness, restraint, and contentment outlast wealth and power, and only one's deeds accompany the soul after death.

image_candidates.scene_text: Mourners with disheveled hair place a dead man's body on a blazing funeral pyre while others turn away and depart.
A symbolic river of life flows with five sensory streams while crocodiles of desire and anger lurk, and a man crosses on a raft of self-control.
A snake calmly sheds its old slough, leaving the empty skin behind as it moves forward renewed.
